By this application under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure (for short "the Code"),
the applicant seeks quashing of the chargesheet No.86 of 2021 for the offences punishable under Sections 498(A), 323 and 114 of Indian Penal Code which has been emerged from FIR being C.R.
No.I- 11208001210091 of 2021 registered with Mahila Police Station, Rajkot City and further proceedings arising thereof.
2.
Heard learned advocate Ms.Ratna Vora appearing for the petitioners, learned advocate Ms.Shivangi Rana appearing for respondent No.2 and learned APP appearing for the respondent State.

sentences.text: It is the case where FIR has been lodged by the first informant against her husband and in-laws for the offences NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/21961/2021 ORDER DATED: 12/03/2025 undefined punishable under Sections 498A, 323 and 114 of IPC.
Learned advocate Ms.Vora appearing for the petitioners submits that settlement has been arrived at between the parties and now there is no disputes between the parties.
Upon above submissions, she submits to quash the FIR.
4. Learned advocate Ms.Rana appearing for the first informant placing on record affidavit sworn in English would confirm the submissions made by learned advocate Ms.Vora.
She would submit that first informant does not want to proceed further in the matter as the parties have amicably settled their dispute.
The affidavit is taken on record.
5. Learned APP Mr.Manan Maheta in given facts and circumstances would submit to pass necessary orders.
6. What could be noticed that the first informant has lodged the FIR against her husband and in-laws for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 323 and 114 of IPC.

The first informant who is present in the Court has placed on record her affidavit stating that now she has no grievance against her husband and in-laws and she has no objection if the impugned FIR is quashed as amicable settlement has been arrived at between the parties.
In the circumstances, putting the petitioners on trial would be a futile exercise.

7. Relevant para of the affidavit of the first informant are as under :
"1.

I state that F.I.R. C.R. No.I-11208001210091 of 2021 is registered with Mahila Police Station, NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/21961/2021 ORDER DATED:
12/03/2025 undefined District Rajkot by me against the petitioners for the offences for the offences under Section 498-A, 323 and 1 14 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
2. I state that after filing of the aforesaid F.I.R. we have entered into an amicable settlement and I have no grievance against the petitioners.
I state that I have no objection if the aforesaid F.I.R. and all other consequential proceedings arising thereto are quashed.
3. I stat that we have amicably resolved our disputes and have mutually decided to obtain divorce.
The petition for divorce is already pending before the concerned court in Rajkot, which was filed by the petitioner no. 1 before court in Ahmedabad but transferred now to the court in Rajkot.
The next hearing date is 20.03.2025 and both the parties i.e. husband and wife have agreed to obtain divorce through consent before the court.
The parties have exchanged most of their belongings and only some belongings are required to be received by me, which as agreed will be given to me on 20.03.2025 before the concerned court.
Therefore, I have no objection if the impugned F.I.R. as well as consequential proceedings arising thereto against the petitioners are quashed.

8.
In view of above, the petition is allowed.

The impugned chargesheet No.86 of 2021 for the offences punishable under Sections 498(A), 323 and 114 of Indian Penal Code which has been emerged from FIR being C.R. No.I-11208001210091 of 2021 registered with Mahila Police Station,
Rajkot City and further proceedings arising thereof are hereby quashed and set aside qua the petitioners herein.
Direct service is permitted.
